title: A safety check would have stopped the loop silently on the machine that runs it
symptom: validate_step_command's is_file() check refused every legitimate template on the lab server, where the loop renders and the run scripts do not exist.

correction_made: A code-held allow-list of script names is the single choke point (a config patch chooses parameters, never a new executable); existence is verified where it is loud, because sbatch fails immediately on a missing script.
